name: Spotify Empire
description: Plugins by @Dillu: mini games and Rose-style admin tools

plugins.name: Mini Games: .wc & .ttt
plugins.description: Chat mini-games with inline buttons: .wc 4-digit guessing and .ttt Tic-Tac-Toe, with challenges and score tables

description_i18n.en: Chat mini-games with inline buttons: .wc 4-digit guessing and .ttt Tic-Tac-Toe, with challenges and score tables
